# External data: LOPAC1280 angiogenesis screen tables

These two spreadsheets are supplementary tables from:

Sailem, H. Z. & Al Haj Zen, A. Morphological landscape of endothelial cell
networks reveals a functional role of glutamate receptors in angiogenesis.
*Scientific Reports* 10, 13829 (2020). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-70440-0

| File | Content | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `41598_2020_70440_MOESM5_ESM.xlsx` | Supplementary Table 2: clustering results (PhenoCluster 1-7) for the LOPAC1280 compounds | `phase5_phenocluster_join.py` |
| `41598_2020_70440_MOESM9_ESM.xlsx` | Supplementary Table 6: drug effects on endothelial network morphology (101 features per compound) | `phase5_phenocluster_join.py`, `phase5_activity_magnitude.py`, `phase5_build_v5.py` |

The files are unmodified copies of the publisher's supplementary downloads.
